evidence.reason: The test's named purpose is to exercise persistence faults at four points, but lines 481-484 swallow any OSError and do not assert that the selected injection fired. If runtime.complete bypasses the patched point, the test proceeds to the fresh completion at line 490 and still passes, so the fault/replay scenario can be silently untested. This is a routine test-correctness defect; assert the chosen injection was invoked (or the expected exception/handled state occurred) before recovery.
